name: causaltrace
description: CausalTrace — Production incident root cause analysis. Takes a Sentry/Datadog error URL or raw stack trace, correlates with git blame + recent PRs, and produces a causal narrative + compile-safe fix via Claude.

sentry_url.description: Sentry issue URL (e.g. https://sentry.io/organizations/acme/issues/123456/). Used to fetch the stack trace via the Sentry API.

stack_trace.description: Raw stack trace text. Used directly if sentry_url is not provided.

repo_path.description: Path to the source repository for git blame correlation.

demo.description: Run with pre-recorded demo data (847 prod errors traced to PR #447 in ~90s).

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for causal narrative and fix generation.

root_cause_commit.description: Git SHA of the commit that introduced the bug.

causal_narrative.description: Human-readable causal chain: error → code path → PR → commit.

fix_code.description: Suggested code fix (text diff or OpenRewrite recipe).

affected_lines.description: Number of source lines implicated in the root cause.

laya_decision.question: Does the implicated code path touch PII or financial data?

examples.title: Demo run (production NullPointerException)
examples.description: Traces 847 CheckoutController 500 errors to a null-guard removal in PR #447 in ~90 seconds.
